'''Malroy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Mantellian Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-backed [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Separatist War]] with the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]]. During the war he was stationed in [[Oradam village]] on [[Avilatan]] where he operated a stall from which he sold armor.<ref name="TOR" />
